svg.title: Analysis Senior Responsible Officer: journey through the playbook
svg.desc: Seven stops on one Business Critical output, from being named to revalidating the designation.

div.b: Analysis Senior Responsible Officer: journey through the playbook

div.span: Seven stops on one Business Critical output, from being named to revalidating the designation.

div.b: 1. You have been named for a piece of Business Critical analysis
2. What am I taking responsibility for?
3. Is the work set up to succeed?

div.div: Be named at scoping, before the analysis starts.
Risks across the lifecycle, and suitability for the intended use.
Confirm the Business Critical status, and the resources and plans for assurance.
Confirm design governance has been followed before the analysis starts.
Stay aware of progress, and be available to approve at delivery.
Approve it as fit for its intended use, before it is used.
Revalidate the designation annually, and before any reuse for a new purpose.

div.span: The evidence trail, read on its own

div.div: The register entry, with your name against it.
Confirmed resources, and the register entry checked.
Nothing recorded. Your availability in the schedule.
Your approval, recorded with what you confirmed.
The revalidated designation, and the register updated.

div.span: What the playbook warns about here

div.div: Being named afterwards does not work. Most of the lifecycle has happened.
You need to be senior enough to carry that.
You shall review the evidence. The Lead Assurer signs off first.
Reuse is the change most likely to invalidate the original assumptions.

div.span: Stop 7 loops back to stop 2. What review finds is what the next revalidation starts from.

Open alongside, at any stop. Deciding your assurance level for how the designation was reached. Business Critical analysis for everything that is true only of Business Critical work. Roles and responsibilities for the older titles you will meet this role under.
NHSBSA Producing Quality Analysis Playbook. Service design artefacts for workshop use. Kainos Software Limited, SOW-DOC053.
